svg.title: chapulin's speed beside OpenSSL over time on the INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C
svg.desc: Each panel is one row of docs/performance.md's table beside OpenSSL. A line is chapulin's speed in multiples of OpenSSL's at each recording. x86-64 AVX-512 gcc: runs on 11 days, from 2026-10-09 to 2026-11-14. x86-64 AVX-512 clang: runs on 11 days, from 2026-10-09 to 2026-11-14.
svg.text: chapulin's speed beside OpenSSL at each recording
INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C, from 2026-10-09 to 2026-11-14. A point above the dashed line at 1 is a run where chapulin was faster.
Each panel has its own scale. A line draws the last run of each day, and the number at its right is the last run's speed.
x86-64 AVX-512 gcc, runs on 11 days
x86-64 AVX-512 clang, runs on 11 days
AES-128-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record sealed
AES-128-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record opened
AES-256-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record sealed
AES-256-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record opened
ChaCha20-Poly1305, 16 KiB encrypted and hashed, no tag
ChaCha20-Poly1305, 16 KiB hashed and decrypted, no tag
